C0402.title: Slack Flaw Allowed Attackers to Force User Redirects and Steal Session Cookies
C0402.summary: In 2019, a researcher on a bug bounty platform discovered a vulnerability in Slack that allowed attackers to forcibly redirect users to a rogue session, enabling theft of their session cookies. The flaw granted access to any data shared within Slack and posed a serious threat to numerous organizations. Slack patched the issue within 24 hours.

references.title: HackerOne Report #737140: Mass Account Takeovers Using HTTP Request Smuggling in Slack
